nodes.label: Album Playlists (Collections feature)
nodes.rationale: Spotify has no notion of album playlists; the author's main pain point. Implemented as a keyword check on playlist names so users keep 'classic' playlists underneath.

nodes.label: Spotify API Restrictions
nodes.rationale: The Web API exposes no folder management, so the playlist list is necessarily flat; the API also refuses non-premium accounts, which is why Beardify is premium-only.

nodes.label: scripts/release.ts Version Bumper
nodes.rationale: Bumps the version in package.json and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json in lockstep, commits, tags and pushes; the tag push is the sole trigger for the release workflow.

nodes.label: In-App Updater
nodes.rationale: On startup (5-second delay, desktop only) it fetches latest.json from the GitHub releases 'latest/download' URL, shows a bottom-right toast when a newer version exists, and verifies the signature before installing. Deliberately inert in the browser build.

edges.source_location: pushes tag which triggers the GitHub Actions release workflow
The update is cryptographically verified before installation
